_comment: Template for a FICTIONAL hacker character/work entry. This is a SEPARATE taxonomy from People/Groups/Events/Tools -- these are not real historical figures. Never mix a fiction entry into the real people/groups directories, and never let a fiction page's tone imply the character is a documented real person. Facts here should be accurate to the actual film/show/book (verified via reviews, cast lists, official sources), not invented lore beyond what the work itself established.
title: Work or Character Title
creator: Director / creator / author
summary: 1-2 sentence neutral description of the work and its significance to hacker pop culture.

characters.name: Character full name
characters.alias: hacker handle used in-story, if any
characters.description: 1-2 sentence factual description of the character's role, sourced to the work itself.
